## WQGuard v1.3.4 (Build 25)

全面消除 iOS 26 / iOS 27 真机预装系统应用、团队自域钥匙串通配符、TestFlight 测试版应用及 `/private/var` 临时路径解包误报，打通企业签 / 侧载重签后的 `WQGuard` 宿主自白名单闭环，并保留全套密码学签名链验真、Mach-O / ZIP64 全链路防绕过解析、2026 最新漏洞特征库、ARM64 `svc #0x80` 直接系统调用扫描与 13 项固件 CVE 暴露雷达。

---

### 中文更新说明

- **iOS 26 / 27 官方预装与第一方应用零误报加固（`InstalledAppRegistryScanner`）**：
  - 完整覆盖驻留于 `/private/var/containers/Bundle/Application/<UUID>/` 且在 CoreTrust 静态缓存中省略 `SignerIdentity` 的 120+ 款 Apple 原厂预装可卸载应用与系统 UI 服务（如设置、Siri、信息、健康、App Store、快捷指令、文件、时钟、日历、备忘录、提醒事项、翻译、遥控器、聚焦、库乐队、Swift Playgrounds 等）及官方非 `com.apple.*` 应用（如 App Store 签名的 `Shazam`）。
  - 完善 Apple 官方内部共享容器命名空间识别（如 `group.tvappservices.*`、`group.is.workflow.*`、`<TeamID>.groups.com.apple.*` 等）与原厂系统级 `no-sandbox` 预装应用边界校验；同时保持对 TrollStore 伪装系统注册、`/var/jb/` 无根越狱路径、`Ad Hoc` / 第三方 `Team ID` / 第三方 `App Group` 伪造包的 100% 高危检出。
- **团队自域钥匙串通配符精准区分（`ExpandedThreatCatalog` / `IPAPackageScanner`）**：
  - 将合法的开发者自身团队前缀钥匙串通配符（`<OwnTeamID>.*` 与历史迁移 `<LegacyAppIDPrefix>.*`）与高危全局通配符 `"*"`、`"com.apple.*"`、跨团队通配符及未签名/Ad-Hoc 通配符严格区分，彻底消除正版 App Store 应用与正常企业签应用（如微博、Erosion、Lokey）的钥匙串误报。
- **TestFlight 官方渠道精准识别（`InstalledAppRegistryScanner` / `CSBlobParser` / `SecurityPipeline`）**：
  - 支持识别 Apple 官方 TestFlight 云端重签名证书 `"TestFlight Beta Distribution"`，避免将 TestFlight 测试版应用（如 Surge、APTV）误标为「企业签」；同时阻止未加密本地侧载克隆包与 FairPlay 加密 TestFlight 安装项混并，并对第三方组织名含 `TestFlight` 字样的伪造企业证书继续按「企业签」严查。
- **真机 `/private/var` 解包路径词法规范化修复（`IPAPackageScanner`）**：
  - 引入不依赖文件系统存在性的纯词法路径规范化 `lexicalStandardizedPath`，彻底修复 iOS 真机 `/private/var/mobile/...` 临时沙盒在解包未签名 `.ipa`（含 `_CodeSignature/` 目录项）时因 `/private` 前缀折叠不一致导致的 `MalformedPackage:ZipSlipOrSymlink` 误报，同时保留对真实 `../` 路径穿越与软链接逃逸的严格拦截。
- **重签宿主自身白名单闭环（`InstalledAppRegistryScanner` / `WhitelistEngine` / `SecurityPipeline`）**：
  - 支持经企业描述文件或个人证书重签（含显式 `application-identifier` 变更、App Group 重写及覆盖安装后缓存快照 UUID 变更）的 iOS 运行宿主 `WQGuard` 正确归入「已知工具」（`KNOWN_TOOL`），同时继续严格拦截任何 `.highRisk` 指标、Apple 系统容器组与主流钱包/通讯应用 App Group 抢占。
- **全量验证**：
  - Swift 严格并发模式下 45 个 XCTest 套件、872 项自动化测试全部通过（0 失败、0 跳过），并完成 Release `wqguard-cli` 与 `WQGuard_v1.3.4.ipa` 成品严格自审（`KNOWN_TOOL`）及实机验证。

---

### English Release Notes

- **Zero False Positives on iOS 26 / 27 Stock & First-Party Apps (`InstalledAppRegistryScanner`)**:
  - Added comprehensive verification for 120+ preinstalled/staged Apple stock apps and UI services under `/private/var/containers/Bundle/Application/<UUID>/` where `installation_proxy` omits `SignerIdentity` (including Settings, Siri, Messages, Health, App Store, Shortcuts, Files, Clock, Calendar, Notes, Reminders, Translate, TV Remote, Spotlight, GarageBand, Swift Playgrounds, etc.) as well as Apple-owned App Store apps (`Shazam`), internal Apple App Group namespaces (`group.tvappservices.*`, `group.is.workflow.*`, `<TeamID>.groups.com.apple.*`), and factory `no-sandbox` stock constraints — while preserving 100% `.highRisk` detection on TrollStore system-registration spoofs, rootless jailbreak paths, and third-party Team ID / App Group spoofs.
- **Own-Team Keychain Wildcard Differentiation (`ExpandedThreatCatalog` / `IPAPackageScanner`)**:
  - Exempts legitimate developer own-team `<OwnTeamID>.*` and `<LegacyAppIDPrefix>.*` `keychain-access-groups` wildcards on signed builds while continuing to flag global `"*"`, `"com.apple.*"`, cross-team wildcards, and ad-hoc/unsigned wildcards as `.highRisk`.
- **Accurate TestFlight Channel Classification (`InstalledAppRegistryScanner` / `CSBlobParser` / `SecurityPipeline`)**:
  - Recognizes Apple's official `"TestFlight Beta Distribution"` cloud re-signing leaf certificate so TestFlight apps (e.g. Surge, APTV) are classified as `TestFlight` (`Safe`) rather than `Enterprise In-House`, while keeping third-party org-name spoofs (`"iPhone Distribution: TestFlight ..."`) under strict enterprise scrutiny.
- **Lexical `/private/var` Temporary Path Canonicalization (`IPAPackageScanner`)**:
  - Replaced filesystem-dependent `standardizedFileURL` prefix checks with pure lexical canonicalization (`lexicalStandardizedPath`), eliminating false-positive `MalformedPackage:ZipSlipOrSymlink` errors when unpacking `.ipa` archives inside iOS `/private/var/mobile/...` temporary directories while catching all real `../` traversal and symlink escapes.
- **Re-signed Host Self-Whitelist Continuity (`InstalledAppRegistryScanner` / `WhitelistEngine` / `SecurityPipeline`)**:
  - Properly recognizes the running iOS `WQGuard` host installation as `KNOWN_TOOL` after enterprise or personal sideload re-signing (including across cached registry snapshots after in-place app updates), while rejecting any `.highRisk` indicator, Apple system group, or wallet/messenger App Group squatting.
- **Verification**:
  - `swift test --disable-sandbox -Xswiftc -strict-concurrency=complete`: 45 XCTest suites, 872/872 tests passing (0 failures, 0 skipped), plus Release `wqguard-cli` and `WQGuard_v1.3.4.ipa` (`KNOWN_TOOL`) self-audit and physical iPhone verification.
